From cfa0ebc9d6d6308564f5174ecb655b9d504b2be5 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Andrew Jones <drjones@redhat.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Jul 2017 15:38:32 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] virtio-net: fix module unloading

Unregister the driver before removing multi-instance hotplug
callbacks. This order avoids the warning issued from
__cpuhp_remove_state_cpuslocked when the number of remaining
instances isn't yet zero.

Fixes: 8017c279196a ("net/virtio-net: Convert to hotplug state machine")
Cc: Sebastian Andrzej Siewior <bigeasy@linutronix.de>
Signed-off-by: Andrew Jones <drjones@redhat.com>
Signed-off-by: Michael S. Tsirkin <mst@redhat.com>

diff --git a/drivers/net/virtio_net.c b/drivers/net/virtio_net.c
index 99a26a9efec1..f41ab0ea942a 100644
--- a/drivers/net/virtio_net.c
+++ b/drivers/net/virtio_net.c
@@ -2743,9 +2743,9 @@ module_init(virtio_net_driver_init);
 
 static __exit void virtio_net_driver_exit(void)
 {
+	unregister_virtio_driver(&virtio_net_driver);
 	cpuhp_remove_multi_state(CPUHP_VIRT_NET_DEAD);
 	cpuhp_remove_multi_state(virtionet_online);
-	unregister_virtio_driver(&virtio_net_driver);
 }
 module_exit(virtio_net_driver_exit);
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/net/virtio_net.c`**
- The order of operations in the `virtio_net_driver_exit` function has been modified. 
- The call to `unregister_virtio_driver(&virtio_net_driver)` has been moved to the beginning of the function, before the calls to `cpuhp_remove_multi_state(CPUHP_VIRT_NET_DEAD)` and `cpuhp_remove_multi_state(virtionet_online)`.

### Relationships
- The change addresses a bug related to the module unloading process in the virtio-net driver. By unregistering the driver first, it ensures that the number of remaining instances is zero before removing the hotplug callbacks, thus preventing warnings from the `__cpuhp_remove_state_cpuslocked` function. This modification is a direct fix for the issue introduced in a previous commit (8017c279196a) that converted the driver to use a hotplug state machine.
